title: Science in Daily Life
seo_title: Grade 3 Science: Science in Daily Life Worksheets (MATATAG)
standard_text: Science is part of daily life. Learners use their senses to observe, describe, compare, classify, measure with simple tools and predict, and they follow safety rules in simple investigations. (summary of the MATATAG Science curriculum, Grade 3, Quarter 1: Materials)
meta_desc: Free Grade 3 Science worksheets (MATATAG, Quarter 1: Materials): observing with the senses, measuring tools, classifying, predicting and working safely. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Scientists observe, ask questions and test ideas.
key_sub: We observe with our five senses.
body_html:
How to think about it

Science is a way of finding out about the world. We see science every day: water boils when we cook rice, clothes dry in the sun, and plants grow in the garden.

Scientists use process skills. They observe with their senses, measure with tools such as a ruler, a thermometer and a weighing scale, classify things into groups, and predict what will happen. They record what they find and work safely.

Example

Which tool measures how hot water is?

Hot and cold

Answer: a thermometer

Example

Is 'The leaf is green' an observation or a prediction?

It uses the eyes.

Answer: an observation

Common mistakes

  • Tasting or smelling unknown things in an activity.
  • Mixing up a guess (prediction) and what you saw (observation).
  • Using different cups when you measure water in a test.
